description: A five-part drum synthesiser — kick, snare, closed hi-hat, open hi-hat and an FX sound — each with its own trigger, output and level

params.text: Raises the pitch of the kick's downward sweep, 0 to 1
Raises the pitch of the snare's tone, 0 to 1
Sets the cutoff of the highpass filter on the noise both hi-hats are made from, 1Hz to 20000Hz
Raises the pitch of the FX sound's sweep, 0 to 1; that sweep falls away faster than the kick's or the snare's
Sets how long its own part sounds, 0.001 to 5 on the knob, giving a hit between a seventh of a second and half a second long
Sets how long both the closed and the open hi-hat sound, 0.001 to 5 on the knob, giving a hit between a seventh of a second and half a second long
Drives its own part's sine oscillator into clipping, 1 to 10; at 1 the tone is a clean sine and higher settings square it off
Drives the FX oscillator into clipping; the knob reads 1 to 49 but the module clamps the drive at 10, so nothing above 10 changes the sound
Fires its own part once; held down, it re-fires four times a second
Sets its own part's level, 0 to 1, both at that part's own output and in the mix output

inputs.text: Added to the kick tune knob, 10V covering its whole range, and at the same time it moves the hi-hat highpass cutoff by 1000Hz per volt
Added to the snare tune knob, 10V covering its whole range
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the hi-hat highpass cutoff is moved by the kick tune input instead, despite the panel putting this jack in the hi-hat column
Added to the FX tune knob, 10V covering its whole range
A rising edge fires its own part once

outputs.text: Carries its own part on its own, at the level set by that part's mix knob
Carries all five parts averaged together and lifted by half again; it falls silent when every mix knob is at 0

notes: a Bap placed immediately to the right adds CV control of the four length settings and of the kick, snare and FX drive
the hi-hat has no drive control; the closed and open hi-hats are the one filtered noise source under two different decay shapes, the closed one much the shorter
every part is cut off hard at the end of its length setting rather than fading out, so a short length clips the tail

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
